title: Amoxtli quiz YAML
description: Describes both quizzes/<id>/index.yaml (shared structure) and quizzes/<id>/<locale>.yaml (per-locale strings). Get autocomplete + validation in VS Code (Red Hat YAML extension).

passThreshold.description: Minimum percentage of correct answers required to pass.

feedback.description: When feedback is shown. Only 'submit' is currently supported.

id.description: Unique id, also used to key the per-locale strings.

type.description: Question type: mcq = multi-select (checkbox), scq = single-choice (radio), tf = true/false.

enumDescriptions.mcq: Multiple-choice — one or more correct answers; learners tick checkboxes.
enumDescriptions.scq: Single-choice — exactly one correct answer; learners pick a radio button.
enumDescriptions.tf: True/false — exactly two options ('true'/'false'), exactly one correct answer.

options.description: Unique option ids, in display order. tf must have exactly 2.

answer.description: Ids of the correct options. scq/tf: exactly one. mcq: one or more.

quizStringsFile.description: Top-level key is the quiz id and must match the quizzes/ directory name.

questions.description: Question strings keyed by the ids from index.yaml.

options.description: Option labels keyed by the option ids from index.yaml. May contain Markdown.

explanation.description: Shown after submit. May contain Markdown.
